items.title: Freeze Cell06 formal shard manifest and sterile input packages
items.context: Use task-inventory.m2 plus cell03-usage-lock as sequencing/usage input only; generate Cell06/A2prime row packages without Cell03 semantic outputs.
items.userSees: User sees "cell06 formal manifest frozen" with expectedRows=1152 and reviewerFamily=not_applicable.

happy.desc: Manifest enumerates 1152 Cell06/A2prime rows with stable input digests

edge.desc: Cell03-derived values are restricted to numeric usage/sequencing limits and never appear as semantic guidance

adversarial.desc: Generated inputs reject forbidden tokens such as session_brief, dev-memory, playbook, reviewer feedback, B-991d summaries, and Cell03 outputs

items.title: Implement formal Docker row runner and receipt writer
items.context: Adapt B-8092 Docker safety and B-991d full runner receipt patterns for Cell06/A2prime formal rows.
items.userSees: User sees "cell06 row completed" or explicit terminal status with row key, runnerHost=local-docker, and receipt digest.
excludes: mounting Proofbound repo into row containers
mounting .lattice or paper repo into row containers

happy.desc: At least one formal row runs in Docker and writes row receipt, final message, events digest, usage if available, and acceptance output

edge.desc: If auth is unavailable or quota fails before start, row is terminal pending_auth/quota_failed and is not counted as completed

adversarial.desc: Unsafe auth bundle/home/repo mounts are blocked before Docker execution

items.title: Run initial formal Cell06 row and validate receipts
items.context: Start with a small formal execution slice to prove the full runner path before scaling to all 1152 rows.
items.userSees: User sees validate-full PASS for the current formal result set and a status table showing completed/pending/exhausted rows.

happy.desc: validate-full passes after the initial formal row execution

edge.desc: Partial execution reports remaining rows as not_started rather than missing/final

adversarial.desc: Contamination scan covers inputs, outputs, events, logs, and generated artifacts

items.title: Prepare resumable full-shard execution status
items.context: After the first row passes, leave a resumable command/status ledger for continuing all remaining rows safely.
items.userSees: User sees exact resume commands and a row-count ledger for full Cell06 execution.

happy.desc: Status ledger reports completed, not_started, pending_auth, failed, quota_failed, timeout, and void rows

edge.desc: Duplicate row ownership or rerun selection is rejected

adversarial.desc: Formal results cannot be merged if prompt/tool/input digests drift from the frozen manifest
